title: Animation Analysis
description: Analyzes resource pack animation files to count animations and bone references. Used to assess animation complexity.

101.title: Animation Count
101.description: Count of animation definitions in resource pack animation files.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of animations as a number

102.title: Bone Count
102.description: Count of bone references used across animations. More bones generally means more complex animations.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of bone references as a number
